laws: Preview/design interaction must not imply production mutation.
Shared Titans are references and are never cloned into an Oros.
Proposal overlays are not canonical relationships.
Visible navigation/preview evidence can prove interaction while authority remains false.
Restart proof must use a genuinely different process when persistence is claimed.
Interaction certification distinguishes REAL_MOUSE_CLICK and REAL_PROCESS_RESTART from same-process reconstruction.
Restart survival is evidence; it is not authority.
Effective readiness may be demoted by current proposal lifecycle even when intrinsic artifact readiness remains audit-true.
Historical confirmations remain historical after rejection and cannot silently reopen a rejected proposal.
A new revision requires a new proposal identity/version/digest; prior rejected evidence stays immutable.
Confirmation is not apply approval. Commercial/export action remains blocked without the correct authority.
Structured status should be primary UX; raw manifests are optional diagnostics.

trackedPreservation: Legacy Hub/Core Git bundles preserve all reachable tracked history; blob-match audit records exceptions.
